title: WALTEUR Observability Contract
description: The observability contract a service must satisfy: structured logging with PII redaction, distributed tracing with context propagation, RED-method metrics with bounded label cardinality, declared SLOs, and health checks that distinguish liveness from readiness.

json.description: True iff logs are emitted as structured JSON (not freeform text).

required_keys.description: Keys every log line must carry (e.g. timestamp, level, trace_id, service).

pii_redaction.description: True iff PII is redacted/masked before logs are written.

otlp_exporter.description: True iff traces are exported via an OTLP (OpenTelemetry) exporter.

context_propagation.description: True iff trace context propagates across service boundaries (W3C traceparent / baggage).

red_method.description: True iff Rate, Errors, Duration are instrumented for every endpoint (RED method).

latency_is_histogram.description: True iff latency is recorded as a histogram (enabling percentiles), not a gauge/average.

max_label_cardinality.description: Upper bound on label/tag cardinality per metric to prevent cardinality explosions.

objective.description: Target value (e.g. 99.9 for availability %, or a latency ms budget).

indicator.description: The SLI that measures this SLO (e.g. 'successful_requests / total_requests').

liveness_distinct_from_readiness.description: True iff liveness and readiness are separate probes (restart vs. route-traffic semantics).

readiness_checks_deps.description: True iff the readiness probe verifies critical downstream dependencies before reporting ready.
